'''Kuninazu no Ōkashima no Mikoto''' (国摩大鹿島命) was an ancient Japanese noble of the {{ill|Kofun period|en|Kofun period|qid=Q459939|lt=Kofun period}} and an ancestor of the {{ill|Nakatomi clan|en|Nakatomi clan|qid=Q1198447|lt=Nakatomi clan}}.

== Overview ==
Kuninazu no Ōkashima no Mikoto is mentioned in the *{{ill|Nihon Shoki|en|Nihon Shoki|qid=Q813935|lt=Nihon Shoki}}* during the 25th year of the reign of {{ill|Emperor Suinin|en|Emperor Suinin|qid=Q314850|lt=Emperor Suinin}} as one of the "Five Daibu" (五大夫), prominent nobles of the era. He is listed alongside {{ill|Take Nunokawa Wake no Mikoto|ja|武渟川別|lt=Takeninukawawake}}, the ancestor of the {{ill|Abe clan|ja|阿部氏}}, and {{ill|Hikokuni-fuki no mikoto|ja|彦国葺|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hikokunifuki|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 彦国葺命|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11487899}}, the ancestor of the {{ill|Wani clan|en|Wani clan|qid=Q11417873|lt=Wani clan}}, solidifying his position as a significant figure in early Japanese history.

== Genealogy ==
Kuninazu no Ōkashima no Mikoto is identified as the son of {{ill|Kushiukameshi no Mikoto|ja|久志宇賀主命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kushiugatsu no Mikoto|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q106106958}} and the father of {{ill|Omikiyama no Mikoto|ja|臣狭山命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Omi Sayama no Mikoto|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q99517230}}, according to genealogical records.<ref>*{{ill|Sonpi Bunmyaku|fa|سونپی بونمیاکو|fr|Sonpi bunmyaku|ja|尊卑分脈|zh|尊卑分脈|qid=Q1704738|lt=Sonpi Bunmyaku}}</ref>
